question: Can the actual host POST route delegate to canonical evidence/lab services using only the existing host-verified Actor and explicitly injected provisioning?
premises: Existing identity resolver is host-owned; synthetic verifier fixtures do not establish actual institutional authentication.
Existing platform/evidence service own authorization, enrollment, exact-version and canonical storage rules.
No available pilot tenant/issuer configuration is inferred from account names or chats.

predictions.acceptance: Exact host route yields original-byte citations with canonical scope and uses no body identity.
Missing resolver/config fails closed; rejected credentials and resolver exceptions yield no identity or private error text.
Role, tenant, enrollment and exact course version/digest violations are rejected before evidence is returned.
Unknown fields/routes and oversized requests cannot dispatch a different operation.
Real host method dispatch and focused canonical library regression suites pass; unexecuted full application startup remains explicitly outside evidence.

simplex.reason: Permission and evidence identity cannot be weighted.

n_ality.reason: Preserve independent actor, tenant, course/version, operation and artifact axes.

continuum.reason: Discrete request/identity checks have no numerical approximation.

fuzzy_logic.reason: Authorization, integrity and schema checks remain Boolean.

alternatives: Direct public deployment is deferred until actual issuer, tenant/provisioning and pilot policy are present.
Explicit injected adapter reuses host authentication instead of adding a second token parser.

bias_checks.trigger: Same team creates adapter and tests
bias_checks.countermeasure: Separate coder review, forged-boundary negatives, test actual host method dispatch; do not claim independent provider verification.

stopping_rule: Focused route integration, required negatives and prior selected regression suite; preserve failures, then exact source commit and parent-linked plan revision.
scope: Code and synthetic local/OCI fixtures only; no real student/private corpus transfer, new paid provider or production mutation.
